title: Language
manualStatus: Selected language: {{language}}. Your choice overrides location.
locationExplanation: Location is requested only after you click. Approximate coordinates stay in this browser and also set sunrise and sunset for Auto appearance. Without a saved location, Auto uses English and a light theme.
approximation: Language is suggested from an offline country map. Borders and multilingual countries can make this suggestion imperfect. Choose any language above. Update location when travelling; there is no background tracking.
locationUnavailable: Could not get your location. Try again or choose a language manually.
locationDenied: Location permission was not granted. Auto uses English and a light theme; manual choices still apply.
storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Changes apply to this tab only.
loadFailed: Could not load this language. Your current language stays active. Check your connection and retry.
